name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2026-01-12, at wavelengths from 0.97 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
